label: Dambalkhacho
note: Georgian GI no. 16: curd balls dried a few days, then ripened 1-2 months in a closed pot, with blue mould traces on grey-brown skin

about.text: A pungent Georgian cheese from Pshavi and Tianeti: salted curd balls dried by the fire and ripened in sealed clay pots until a mould grows on them.
